data.name: Arcane Bloodrage
data.description: When you enter a bloodrage, you can choose one of the following spells and apply its effects on you: Blur, Protection from Arrows, Resist Energy (choose one energy type), or Spider Climb. The effects of the spell last for as long as the bloodrage lasts, regardless of its normal duration.

When you enter a bloodrage, you can choose one of the following spells and apply its effects on you: Blur, Protection from Arrows, Resist Energy (choose one energy type), or Spider Climb. The effects of the spell last for as long as the bloodrage lasts, regardless of its normal duration.
